spans.s: एनद्, i. e. ए-न (cf. एतद् and एव; न is an old pron. base), pron. which forms only the acc. sing., du. pl., instr. sing., and gen. loc. du., which are substituted for the corresponding cases of इदम् and एतत्, This, when used substantively, He, She, It, and without any stress,

.
 --Cf. Goth. ainaha, ains; A.S. ân; Lat. oinos, unus; οἴνη.
एनस् + विन्, adj., f. नी, m. A sinner,
